units.text: Evidence overwhelmingly confirms Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics included 116 medal events across 8 sports and 16 disciplines. Multiple sources (BBC Sport, Wikipedia, IOC-linked LinkedIn article, KXAN/The Hill, and medal table totals) independently cite the 116 event count.

judgement.reason: Core 116 events across 8 sports/16 disciplines is supported by Olympedia, LinkedIn, The Hill/KXAN, and Wikipedia, but the claimed BBC Sport source is not among the provided passages and the medal-table passage does not explicitly state 116 events.

units.text: Sources concur that 116 gold medal events were contested, as reflected in the final medal table totals row and repeated across Olympic coverage.

citations.title: Final medal count at the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics and Paralympics | NBC Olympics

judgement.reason: The NBC totals row shows 116 gold medals, and Wikipedia states 116 medal events, which directly supports that 116 gold medal events were contested and repeated across coverage.

units.text: Medal event count is consistent across both Winter and Paralympic contexts: 116 gold events totaling 349 medals across 740 total medals awarded to Olympic athletes.

citations.title: Final medal count at the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics and Paralympics | NBC Olympics
2026 Winter Olympics: What you need to know in six charts - BBC Sport

judgement.reason: The passages support 116 medal events, 349 total medals in the Winter table, and 740 medals awarded to Olympic athletes, but they state Paralympians were awarded 352 medals and give no Paralympic event count, so the claimed consistency across both Winter and Paralympic contexts is not supported.
